narr: A broad upper trough extended from the Great Lakes to northeast Texas. An upper-level disturbance moving through the Mid-South ignited convection across the Memphis metropolitan area during the late morning hours on July 25, 2024. A very moist airmass was in place across the region with anomalous precipitable water values of over 2 inches. The thunderstorms were slow moving resulting in heavy rainfall and flash flooding.
ev: Heavy rain caused flash flooding in parts of Horn Lake. A vehicle was stalled in floodwaters on Dunbarton Drive just north of Goodman Road. The intersection of Dunbarton Drive and Sherry Drive was flooded with a few streets in the nearby vicinity closed due to floodwaters.
Nail Road at Highway 61 was closed due to flooding.
